query: Which sensitivity analyses and bounding approaches (sample restriction, IPW, selection models, migration/mortality bounds) best quantify bias from parental/child migration and cohort mortality?

response.query: Which sensitivity analyses and bounding approaches (sample restriction, IPW, selection models, migration/mortality bounds) best quantify bias from parental/child migration and cohort mortality?
response.answer: Sample restriction, inverse probability weighting (IPW), and selection models best quantify bias from parental/child migration and cohort mortality. Migration/mortality bounds provide additional sensitivity analysis.
